description: This file is a shell script that automates testing of git-p4 integrations with a Perforce depot. It includes functions to set up test scenarios, execute various test cases on submissions, descriptions, shelved changes, and updates, as well as interacting with external commands like p4, git, and shell utilities.

methods.name: make_job
methods.description: Creates a Perforce job with a specified name and description.

methods.name: last_shelve
methods.description: Retrieves the latest shelved change list number from Perforce.

methods.name: make_shelved_cl
methods.description: Creates a new shelved changelist with a given commit message.
